newsitem.title: USA: El Salvador seeks U.S. PL-480 vegoil and tallow.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador seeks U.S. PL-480 vegoil and tallow.

text.p: El Salvador was tendering for about 4,500 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 1,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. export agent said.
Contracts will be awarded on the basis of maximum five percent less at buyer's option.
The shipment dates for both the sunflowerseed oil and PBSY cottonseed oil were slated for July 20-Aug 5. Offers are to be received no later than June 16 and remain valid June 17.
El Salvador was also seeking on June 16 about 1,650 tonnes of tallow and approximately 800 tonnes of top white tallow under the U.S. PL-480 export program.
Shipment dates for both lots of tallow were set for July 20-Aug 5.
